name: 🫑 Cottage Cheese Dip & Peppers
tagline: Blend cottage cheese smooth with ranch seasoning: a protein-packed dip for sweet peppers.

steps.text: Blend the cottage cheese, ranch seasoning and lemon juice until totally smooth.
Taste and add more ranch seasoning if you like.
Halve the mini peppers and pull out the seeds.
Serve the dip in a bowl with peppers and carrots around it.

chef_tip: Blend it really smooth, a full minute. The curds disappear and nobody can tell it's cottage cheese.
make_ahead: Dip keeps 4 days in the fridge; it thickens overnight.
leftovers: Use as a sandwich spread or baked-potato topping.
